title: Daneel AILANG executor with Gemini Google Search grounding
binding_decisions: D1 summary tail plus transcript artifact
D2 caps IO FS Clock Net AI Process; git status/diff/log only; no Env; host-enumerated net; default CLI plus lock
D4 host dispatch only; malformed Request becomes BLOCKED

velocity.basis: Shallow checkout prevented historical LOC/day calculation; design estimate extended for grounded search and release gate

features.description: Bind Policy.AIProvider in run --policy and refuse every widening or inconsistent configuration
acceptance_criteria: AI plus ai_provider=stub runs without --ai
--ai plus --policy is refused with a named error
AI without ai_provider and ai_provider without AI are refused
A per-call model cannot escape the policy-bound provider
Policy diagnostic records provider and digest

features.description: Add std/ai grounded search returning answer text and normalized sources through Gemini native google_search
acceptance_criteria: Gemini request contains tools with native google_search block
Recorded sanitized fixture returns answer text and non-empty sources
Non-Gemini providers return typed CapabilityNotSupported
Ordinary call, callJson, and step wire requests remain unchanged
Runnable AILANG example checks and stdlib interface artifacts are frozen

features.description: Release M1 and M2 and verify the exact binary before multivac emits new configuration keys
acceptance_criteria: Release CI and AILANG quality gates pass
Released binary reports expected version and recognizes every planned policy key
Smoke policy produces a non-empty digest without silent unknown-key loss
No multivac configuration is deployed before this gate passes

features.description: Deploy the daneel-executor registry entry, ratified policy, and workspace task template through the fixed push trigger
acceptance_criteria: net_allow is enumerated from Daneel host source and recorded
Effective caps include Process with only git status/diff/log and exclude Env
Full default cli_allow plus lock is effective
Executor model is glm-5.3-flash and grounded AILANG handler resolves to Gemini
Template deploys on push after trigger fix 57099e2 without image rebuild
Scratch path dependency lock and policy admission work in the real container

features.description: Implement Daneel host dispatch/completion consumption and ext/search with Authority caps AI and Net
acceptance_criteria: ailang prompt is consulted before editing AILANG files
ext/search Authority is exactly [AI, Net]
Capability dispatches a typed Request to only daneel-executor
Completion consumer parses ANSWER and mails success or structured blocked/failed reason
Malformed Request yields BLOCKED and absent ANSWER is never success
Package smokes and completion parser tests pass

features.description: Prove the live Gemini-grounded first use, authority boundaries, no-rebuild behavior, and implementation record
acceptance_criteria: Host-dispatched Google Search grounding returns answer text and sources through summary
Malformed Request is BLOCKED; Env, git push, arbitrary Process, and unlisted domains are refused
git status, git diff, and git log are admitted
Second task sees pushed template or ext change without image rebuild
Evidence records policy digest, model, sources, tokens, cost, release version, and exact net hosts
Stale no-Process statements in the design doc are corrected
